title: Suhyup Bank reports to regulator that data of 54 customers leaked in hack, Money Today says
date_note: The article is dated 26 November and says the bank reported to the Financial Supervisory Service that day; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: country; the article gives no city
summary: Money Today reports Suhyup Bank is the fifth bank hit in a series of hacks. It and Newsis say personal data of 54 customers, including loan and credit information and addresses, leaked and the bank reported it to the Financial Supervisory Service. Newsis quotes the bank saying the system was a separate tuition payment system, not internet banking.
plain: Money Today reports that Suhyup Bank, the fifth bank hit, had personal data of 54 customers leaked. The bank has reported it to the financial regulator and says it will notify those customers.
exec: Money Today reports a fifth Korean bank hit; Suhyup Bank says it reported to the financial regulator and will notify the 54 customers whose data leaked.
action: Suhyup Bank says, per Money Today, it will notify affected customers, set up a victim reporting centre and develop a lookup system for customers to check whether their data leaked.
impact: Personal data of 54 customers (loan and credit information, addresses) leaked, per Money Today.
